diagnostics.description: Test latency, packet loss and network paths from this server to your target.
diagnostics.empty: Choose a tool and enter a target to start
diagnostics.mtr_hint: MTR updates live, with up to 10 probes per hop.
diagnostics.complete_hint: The test has ended. Check replies, packet loss and the final hop to determine reachability.

errors.invalid_target: Enter a valid IPv4, IPv6 or domain (such as example.com). URLs, ports, CIDRs and command arguments are not allowed.
errors.disabled: This tool is disabled on the server.
errors.busy: A test is already running or the server is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.resolve_failed: Cannot resolve this target. Check the address and selected IP version.
errors.unavailable: This diagnostic tool is not installed on the server.
errors.execution_failed: The test failed. Check the raw output for details.
errors.output_limit: Output exceeded the limit or could not be read. The test was stopped.
errors.protocol_error: Invalid diagnostic message. Please try again.
errors.connection_failed: Connection failed or disconnected. Check your network or retry shortly; the server may be busy.

file_speedtest_hint: Download a test file directly from this server to measure throughput.

traffic_hint: Real-time throughput of the server's network interfaces.
